name: Jinguu Naru
source:
Mother of the Jinguu family. 
A tough-gal type who loves alcohol and gambling. She has a unique way of speaking, a mix of different dialects.

[From the [url=https://www.entergram.co.jp/puramaiwars/]official website[/url]]
